stageNotes: Stage 1: canonical = https://www.gagnonsports.com (apex returned curl 000 / no response; www returns 200 with <link rel='canonical' href='https://www.gagnonsports.com/'>).

Stage 2: 8-batch heavy probe. cf-ray on every batch + __cf_bm cookie; all main paths 200 across UAs and rapid burst (10/10). Honeypot WP paths (/wp-admin /wp-login /xmlrpc) return 403 — origin rule, not WAF challenge (not a WordPress site so no actual gate). SQLi UNION SELECT triggers 403 (rule-selective). XSS payload 200. No cf challenge body, no Sucuri/Incapsula/sgcaptcha/MalCare/Wordfence markers. Verdict: Cloudflare-passive in front of catalog crawl path; setting hasWaf=false (operational definition: WAF does not gate the crawler).

Stage 3: Platform = lightspeed-ecom. Multiple signals: cdn.shoplightspeed.com everywhere, Generated comment from Lightspeed Netherlands B.V., shop id 626968 in CDN paths, InStijlMedia Dream theme, .html product URL suffix, pageN.html pagination. adapterType=generic-retail per platform-mapping table. No age-gate or login wall on storefront.

Stage 4: Walked nav + sitemap. Top-level firearm-relevant categories: /firearms/* (nested tile-tile-leaf) and /hunting/* (mostly leaf). Parent tile pages return 0 products + 'No products found' template residue — must walk LEAF categories (depth 3-4). Excluded per Rule C: /fishing/, /ice-fishing/, /outdoor-recreation/, /hunting/clothing-footwear/ (pure apparel). Sale page is fishing-heavy with minor /sale/hunting-super-specials/ — its products almost certainly overlap firearm leaves so not added. /collection/ is global aggregator covering 13,731 products = full sitemap; not added because it dilutes firearm-relevant signal-to-noise heavily (~80% non-firearm). Mistake-26 hazard: LightSpeed ?page=N is silently ignored — must use suffix-replace pageN.html.

Stage 5: Pagination type=suffix-replace (Mistake 26). Verified: /firearms/new-firearms/centerfire-rifles/?limit=100 returned 47 (single page); /firearms/new-firearms/centerfire-rifles/page2.html returned 23 different products from page 1 (zero-overlap). perPage probed: limit option 100 honored (Lightspeed tui-limit UI exposes 4/8/12/16/20/24/100). Default is 24. Use 100 for fewer requests.

Stage 6: 3-outcome counter-control on /firearms/new-firearms/centerfire-rifles/ — default first product = akdas-alcor; ?sort=newest first = browning-bar-mark-4 (different); ?sort=asc first = akdas (= default; default is alpha-asc). Verdict: honored. sortParam = ?sort=newest. Sort baked into pagination template per Mistake 26: page{N}.html?sort=newest.

Stage 7: Watermark = navigate-from-watermark. Sort=newest verified; LightSpeed has no public ?modified_after= API. Plus /index.rss exposes a New-Products RSS feed (additional newest signal if needed).

Stage 8: expectedProductCount=2706 (firearm-relevant subset, sum of per-leaf counts). productCountMethod = html-pagination via per-leaf walks. Cross-check: full /collection/ aggregator walks to page 138 (last page has 31 of 100), giving 13,731 — matches sitemap.xml product-URL count exactly. Site is ~80% non-firearm; running expectedProductCount against full sitemap would fail the 5% drift gate against firearm-relevant catalogUrls coverage.
